Vanessa / team — thanks for the ping and the redlines. Quick read and immediate guidance: 

- Order Form signatory: Standard practice is that we accept an e-signed Order Form from an authorized Redwood sales representative for transactions under $250k and without contract amendments. If the counterparty redlines commercial terms or adds non-standard obligations to the Order Form, we require an authorized signatory from Legal (signature page from an officer). For CedarPoint's edits, I see a handful of changes to the indemnity and termination clauses in the MSA (see inline comments in attached).

- MSA redline handling: I recommend consolidated counter-proposal. Redline-by-redline on their draft will create noise and delay. I'll prepare a consolidated redline that:
  * preserves our limitation of liability and indemnity language (we should push back on expansion)
  * accepts some clarifications to notification and data handling sections
  * flags the termination-for-convenience edits as non-starter without commercial concessions

- Absolute blockers we need evidence for: insurance (they removed minimum limits in §12) and export controls language that broadens obligations. If they cannot restore commercial insurance minimums, we will need an exception routed to Ops/Finance.

Action items: 
- Marissa will circulate a consolidated redline by end of day 5/10.
- Mateo: please provide Coupa field mapping values below so I can include the appropriate note to procurement.

I'll also confirm signatory rules in the reply to Alyssa so procurement can proceed with Coupa registration while we finalize legal.

Marissa Cole

Hi Alyssa — thanks for sending the redlines and the supplier form. Short answers and next steps: 

- Order Form signing: For your deal size (per our intake) and since there are edits to the MSA, our legal team will prepare a consolidated counter to the MSA. While that is in flight, we can accept an e-signed Order Form from our Sales rep to provision the tenant in Coupa and enable PO routing, but final contract effectiveness will be tied to execution of the MSA/counter. If CedarPoint needs the Order Form to be signed by an officer because of internal controls, we can escalate, but it will add a day or two.

- Coupa field guidance (Mateo provided):
  * GL code format: 6-digit numeric (e.g., 605210) — leave blank if not applicable, we will populate on our side once POs issue.
  * PO acknowledgement contact: use procurement@cedarpoint-med.com and Main AP contact for invoice routing (we can accept third-party EDI later).
  * SFTP / EDI: optional for initial onboarding. If you want SFTP now, we'll send SFTP host + username after supplier activation.

- Legal cadence: Marissa will send our consolidated redline by end of day tomorrow (5/11). If you'd prefer a call to walk the redlines, we can do a 30-min review — propose 5/12 11:00am ET.

Attached: orderform-signatory-matrix.xlsx (shows when sales signature acceptable vs. exec sign required).

Please confirm whether procurement@cedarpoint-med.com is the correct ack contact and whether you want the DocuSign flow or a manual PDF signature. Once you confirm, we'll proceed with Coupa activation and send the DocuSign link for the Order Form.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.
